FGT.Sheet.Name: Name
FGT.Settings.TurnsPerRoundHint: 3 for the Great Holy Grail War, 8 for the Holy Grail War, 15 for post-True-Masters Snowfield. Locked once a match is in progress.
FGT.Settings.ShowDamagePreview: Show speculative damage in the targeting preview
FGT.Settings.ShowOverlaysHint: Draw the ZON ring around a selected Servant's Master, an enemy's attack range when you hover it, and a Master's protection radius while a Servant is guarding it.
FGT.Settings.AutoDeclineLuckBelow: Auto-decline Luck Checks below this success chance (%)
FGT.Settings.LockedDuringMatch: "{key}" cannot be changed while a match is in progress: it would invalidate every stored effect duration on the board.
FGT.Attack.NoTarget: Target a unit first (select it and press T, or right-click → Target).
FGT.Prompt.acceptOrEscape: Accept the hit, or spend a Command Spell?
FGT.Settings.GrandOrderHint: Switches off the rules that assume rival Masters: the multi-Servant tax, and forced-attack compulsions against allied units.
FGT.Victory.grailObtained: The Holy Grail has been obtained!
FGT.Victory.noWinner: The Holy Grail was destroyed. There are no winners.
FGT.Settings.CommandSpellTimeoutHint: Seconds a Command Spell offer waits before the resolution continues as if declined. 0 disables the timeout.
FGT.Reaction.CounterHint: Attack back; a Counter cannot itself be Countered
FGT.HUD.Title: Turn
FGT.HUD.DelayHint: Go this many places later among the factions that have not acted yet. It lasts for this Round only.
FGT.Targeting.ChoosePanel: Choose a panel — right-click or Escape to cancel.
FGT.Targeting.NoTargets: No legal targets for this ability.
FGT.Targeting.CasterNotPlaced: {name} has no token on this scene, so it has nothing to attack from.
FGT.Targeting.NothingInReach: Nothing is in reach of this ability.
FGT.Targeting.ModeDirection: choose a direction — hover or use the arrow keys, click or Enter to confirm
FGT.Targeting.ModePanel: choose a panel inside the highlighted area
FGT.Targeting.ModeUnit: choose a target — Tab cycles, click or Enter to confirm
FGT.Sheet.NoFactionHint: No faction set — this Unit is neutral to everyone, so nothing can target it and it can target nothing.
FGT.Targeting.NoFactions: No legal targets: no Unit on this scene has a faction set, so every Unit is neutral to every other. Set a Faction on each Unit's sheet (matching ids are allies).
FGT.Sheet.NoFactionsAtAll: No factions exist yet. A GM creates them in Settings → Configure Settings → F/GT → Factions, then each Unit picks one here.
FGT.Factions.Title: Factions
FGT.Factions.MenuHint: Create the factions in this match, assign a player to each, and declare alliances.
FGT.Factions.Intro: Units pick their faction from this list. Units in the same faction, or in factions allied to each other, are allies; everyone else is an enemy. A Unit with no faction is neutral to everyone and cannot be targeted.
FGT.Factions.Empty: No factions yet. Add one to begin.
FGT.Factions.Name: Name
FGT.Factions.DeleteWarn: Delete "{name}"? {count} Unit(s) currently belong to it and will be left with no faction.
FGT.HUD.TickHint: The global turn count (◈). Every duration in the game is quoted in multiples and fractions of it.
FGT.Combat.AllFactionsIn: Every faction is already in this combat.
FGT.Combat.UnknownFaction: No faction with the id "{id}" is in the roster.
FGT.Combat.NoRoster: There are no factions yet, so a match has nobody to give turns to. Create them in Settings → Configure Settings → F/GT → Factions, then add them to the combat.
FGT.Combat.NoFactionsInCombat: This combat has no factions in it, so no turn can be taken. Right-click the combat in the tracker and choose "Add Every Faction".
FGT.Combat.PopulateBody: Turns in F/GT belong to factions, not to tokens. Add all {count} ({names}) and the GM's slot to this combat now?
FGT.Movement.NotYourTurn: You cannot move {name} now — it is {faction}'s turn.
FGT.Settings.TargetingReviewHint: After aiming, show the list of units the area caught — and the ones the rules excluded, with the reason — so you can adjust or re-aim before the attack is declared.
FGT.Summon.Title: Summon a Servant
FGT.Summon.GrantsHint: Parameter steps this Servant's Master grants it — Kaleidoscope grants +1 to one parameter. Granted steps move Base Attack by ±10 each, but only for STR and MAG.
FGT.Summon.Locked: The match has started, so the setup rolls are locked.
FGT.Summon.Unknown: No Servant with the content id "{id}" is in any compendium.
FGT.Summon.DropRefused: A Servant dragged straight from a compendium would carry the template's numbers, not its own. Opening the summon dialog instead.
FGT.Summon.SetupHint: Rolls this Master's Health, Agility, Luck, Base Attack and Command Spells.
FGT.Copy.Title: Wisdom of Dún Scáith
FGT.Copy.Hint: Choose which Skills to offer {name}. Their player picks {count} of them, and each copy takes this Skill's own rank and cooldown.
FGT.Copy.PreferredOnly: Show only Rank B–A (the stated preference)
FGT.Copy.Nothing: Nothing on the field can be copied: every Skill is a Class Skill, Rank EX, passive, or marked uncopyable.
FGT.Copy.BandEmpty: No Skill on the field is Rank B–A. Untick the band to see the rest.
FGT.Copy.NeedMore: Offer at least {count} Skills — the player has to pick that many.
FGT.Copy.PickHint: Pick {count} Skills to use as effects of this Skill.
FGT.Copy.NoAnswer: The player did not answer. Your selection is still here.
FGT.Choice.Title: Choose
FGT.Choice.AtLimit: You have already picked {count}. Untick one to change it.
FGT.Prompt.LuckCheckBody: {name} may make a {check} Luck Check. It costs 1 Luck whether or not it succeeds ({luck} left).
FGT.Log.Title: Game Log
FGT.Log.OverrideHint: The original entry stays in the record, struck through. A reason is required — an unexplained override is indistinguishable from a bug in the log.
FGT.Log.OverrideNeedsReason: A GM override must carry a reason.
FGT.Anchor.selfHint: Placed on the Unit using the ability.
FGT.Anchor.targetUnitHint: Placed on a Unit the player picks, within range.
FGT.Anchor.pointHint: Placed on any panel the player picks, occupied or not.
FGT.Anchor.ownerMasterHint: Placed on the contracted Master — used by ZON-relative abilities.
FGT.Shape.unitHint: Whatever the target occupies, however large it is.
FGT.Shape.squareHint: An N×N block centred on the anchor. Odd sizes centre exactly.
FGT.Shape.rectHint: A W×H block. From a directional anchor it projects outward from the caster.
FGT.Shape.chebyshevRadiusHint: Every panel within R, diagonals counting as one.
FGT.Shape.attackRangeHint: The octagonal shape a normal attack uses.
FGT.Shape.ringHint: The boundary at exactly R — the interior is not covered.
FGT.Shape.lineHint: A straight run of panels away from the anchor.
FGT.Shape.orientedRectHint: A W×H block projected in a chosen direction.
FGT.Shape.pathHint: Every panel the caster moved through — used by Riding Attack.
FGT.Shape.zoneHint: Every panel of a named Zone, whatever its shape.
FGT.Shape.bandedHint: Concentric bands, each with its own effect.
FGT.Editor.Title: Ability editor
FGT.Editor.CannotSave: {count} problem(s) must be fixed before this can be saved.
FGT.Editor.Name: Name
FGT.Editor.AdvancedHint: These default to the derived values and are rarely worth changing. "Categorized as NP" is what NP Seal and NP damage bonuses read.
FGT.Editor.PhasesHint: Run in order. An applyEffects before its damage applies to a Unit that has not been hit yet.
FGT.HUD.Facing: Facing — changing it does not end the turn
FGT.Master.NoServants: No Servants are contracted to this Master.
FGT.Master.TaxWarning: At 25 Health or less this Master cannot order more than one Servant to Act.
FGT.Master.EssenceLost: The Essence and its granted effects are lost when this Master dies.
FGT.Editor.UnknownKey: {where} uses "{key}", which the engine cannot execute.
FGT.Editor.NeedsIntentional: {where} overrides its priority band without an "@intentional" note saying why (§24.6).
FGT.Editor.UnknownEffect: {where} applies "{id}", which is not in the effect registry.
FGT.Editor.UnknownShape: "{shape}" is not a shape the targeting resolver can expand.
FGT.Editor.UnknownAnchor: "{anchor}" is not an anchor the targeting resolver knows.
FGT.Editor.BadTick: The {where} is not a valid duration: {message}
FGT.Editor.DoesNothing: This ability has no phases and no rule elements, so it will do nothing.
FGT.Await.NeedsGM: This needs a GM ruling; nothing was decided automatically.
FGT.Await.TimedOut: No answer — took the option that spends nothing.
